events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.summary: Classic cars fill downtown Cayucos 8am–4pm. Live band, beer garden & BBQ one block from the beach.

events.title: Pacific Makers Market
events.summary: 3rd Annual artisan market 11am–4pm with local vendors, live music, food & drinks to kick off holiday shopping.

events.title: Shoreline Inn Holiday Light Display
events.venue: Shoreline Inn on the Beach, 1 N Ocean Ave, Cayucos
events.summary: Over 25,000 lights illuminate the Shoreline Inn nightly 6–11:30pm from Thanksgiving through Jan 6. Free to view.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Tree Lighting
events.venue: Corner of D Street & Ocean Avenue, Cayucos
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Rotary
events.summary: Free outdoor tree lighting 5–6:30pm with live music, carolers from Cayucos Community Church & Santa's arrival by fire engine.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Wonderland Walk
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Lioness Club
events.summary: Free holiday stroll along Ocean Ave 3–6pm: visit Santa, free horse-drawn carriage rides, kids' crafts & extended shop hours.
